title: Recording to MIDI draft
description: Choose a recording to estimate notes, their timing, and pitch bends. A single instrument recorded on its own works best.
inputHint: WAV, MP3 or FLAC · up to 2 minutes · 50 MiB maximum
working: Choose your file, then wait while its notes are estimated.
cancelled: Transcription cancelled. You can choose another recording.
cancelFailed: The cancel request could not be delivered. Wait for this transcription to finish before choosing another file.
cancelUnconfirmed: The transcription ended, but its cancellation could not be confirmed. The result was not opened. You can choose another recording.
empty: No notes were found in this recording. Try a clearer recording of one instrument or a shorter phrase.
reviewHint: This is an estimated draft. Listen and check the notes before rehearsal. Save the MIDI to edit it in a DAW or score editor.
saveFailed: The MIDI draft could not be saved. Choose another location and try again.
saveBusy: Another MIDI save is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
saveStale: This draft is no longer available for saving. Transcribe the recording again.
saveInvalid: MIDI saving was rejected. Choose a file name ending in .mid or .midi and try again.
saveDraftInvalid: The MIDI draft could not be verified for saving. Transcribe the recording again.
saveUnavailable: Save MIDI drafts in the BandScope desktop app.
previewPlaying: Playing estimated notes with synth sound.
previewHint: The preview uses a simple synth sound. It is not the original recording.
previewLimit: This recording has more than 32 overlapping notes. The synth preview may omit some notes; the MIDI keeps them.
previewFailed: Synth playback could not start. You can still save the MIDI draft.
bendWarning: Pitch bends on overlapping notes were omitted from the MIDI and preview to keep other notes in tune.
peakWarning: The recording's peak level was adjusted before transcription.
clippedWarning: Note times extending beyond the recording were adjusted.
omittedWarning: Notes outside the supported range or too short to export were omitted.
errorUnavailable: Transcription requires the BandScope desktop app with its analysis engine installed.
errorBusy: Another transcription is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errorAudio: This recording could not be read or exceeds the input limits. Choose a supported recording of up to 2 minutes and 50 MiB.
errorModel: The verified Basic Pitch model is unavailable. Check the desktop installation before trying again.
errorComplex: This recording produced too many notes or bends. Try a shorter phrase recorded with one instrument.
errorInvalid: The transcription result could not be verified. It was not opened. Try another recording.
errorTimeout: Transcription ran out of time. Try a shorter phrase recorded with one instrument.
errorCleanup: Transcription cleanup could not be completed. Reopen the app before trying again.
errorFailed: Transcription did not finish. Try a shorter recording or choose the file again.
mapEmpty: There are no note estimates to display for this part.
